en: Ah, Captain! Thanks for coming.

Evelysse, what on earth are
you planning to do in the
summoning room? Please tell
us already!
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Miss Eve -> Evelysse (Global drops さん), the user's decision; the honorific dropped (Global's practice) is a rewording beyond the name: agent row, needs a person's review

en: Today, I want to try out an\nadvanced application of my\nsummoning magic.

Advanced... like summoning
some super strong warrior? I'm
going to request the strongest
hero ever!
Hmm, it's a bit hard to explain\nproperly...

With normal summoning, we
bring a warrior here to the ship
as a physical entity to join us,
right?

With this advanced technique,
we trace the memories and
recollections of warriors
drifting in space and enter into
them.
I think we can use it to find\npotential new allies or for\ncombat image training.
That's amazing!
Is it safe?
But it must be expensive,\nright?
Right?! Give me more praise\nevery once in a while!
That's not fair, Evelysse! I worked\nso hard cleaning and preparing\nthis room too...
note: name (en-evelysse 2026-10-08): Eve -> Evelysse, the user's decision

en:
I know, I know. Coro, you
worked really hard to help
deliver this surprise to the
Captain.

Since we're just entering a
memory, it'll probably feel like
we're having a very vivid
dream.

We aren't actually warping to a
distant planet or time, so we
can return immediately once
the spell is broken.
I see... so it's like experiencing\na virtual space in the Holodeck.\nThis sounds exciting, Captain!
Hehehe...
Actually, this application of the\nspell is free! It doesn't even\nrequire any Gems!
Whaaaat?! Really?!
Coro, Captain, thanks for the\ngreat reactions.
To summon a warrior into\nphysical form, you need the\npower of Gems.

But if it's just to temporarily
awaken a memory, I can
manage it on my own without
relying on Gems.
Though, if I overdo it, I'll get\nexhausted, so I can't keep it up\nfor very long.
Now, enough talking. Let's get\nstarted.
I can feel the strong will of a\ncertain warrior right now. I'm\ngoing in.
We've arrived. ...Is this a\nmountain path?
Wow, this feels so real!
So, is "Arsensi" inside this\nmemory?

Not by name, but as a certain
someone. I can't tell who the
owner of the memory is just by
entering.
???: ...To think that you all are\ninvolved...
???: Albel!
I-I heard something! Is it a\nghost?
It must be the owner of the\nmemory. Let's head toward the\nvoice!
Albel Nox! How dare you do\nthat to my subordinates!
Hm? Oh, these guys? They\nresisted, so I simply dealt with\nthem.
Though they were completely\ntoothless, hahahaha!
Take that!
Ugh... uuu...
...It hurts...
I won't forgive you...
You...
Why? I'm feeling rather\nfrustrated. So I'm not letting\nyou off easy today.
I wouldn't mind taking on those\npests watching with such\ninterest in the back as well.
...Hm? What did you say!?
Y-you guys, when did you get\nhere? You don't seem to be\nAlbel's allies...
Captain, that midriff-baring\nswordsman Albel seems more\nthan ready to fight us too.
Let's just accept the challenge.\nWe didn't come here to watch\na movie, after all.

Since we're inside a memory,
the Uncharted Planet
Protection Treaty doesn't
apply, Captain!
Heh, you're gonna help us?\nWell, thanks.
Albel is stronger than he looks.\nDon't let your guard down.
Have you finished chatting?\nNot that it matters to me how\nmany more pests show up.
Don't underestimate us!
Just try it. I'll make you regret\nacting so smug!
I look forward to it. ...Well, do\nyour best.
...Not bad... but... Gah!!
Damn it... This can't be\nhappening!
You still want more?
...Of course I do! I won't be\nbeaten by the likes of you!\nGuh...!!
Let's go, Cliff.
Huh?

We should get Tynave and the
others to a doctor as soon as
possible. There's no point in
staying here.
...You're right.
But hey, wouldn't it be better\nto finish this guy off right\nnow?
Maybe so, but I don't have a\ntaste for kicking someone while\nthey're down.
...Just like him.
Haha, fair enough. You're right.\nKicking someone while they're\ndown isn't cool.
Um, Captain... was it? Thank\nyou very much. We have to\nhurry, so we'll be going.
My thanks as well. Thank you.
Thanks for the help. See ya.

They're gone... It looks like
they're transporting an injured
person and a lot of luggage
somewhere.
Gwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!
Only Albel-san was left behind.\nWhich means...

Albel is the owner of this
memory. He held onto the
events of that battle very
deeply.
It seems those three already\nhad a history with him.
Damn it... damn pests...
...You lot, you're still here? Are\nyou planning to mock me?
No, I suppose that's only\nnatural. Because I... I lost...
I'm the... damn pest...
Hey, why do you think I lost?
Figure it out yourself.
You had no allies to rely on.
Eat a banana.
...Heh. I suppose that's true...
There's no point if I can't win\nby my own strength... I was a\nfool to even ask...
What is wrong with this man?\nHe's the one who asked in the\nfirst place.
Allies...? Huddling together for\ncomfort is something only\npests do...
What? You're saying that\nbelieving in your allies is where\ntrue strength lies...?

Dammit! What could someone
like you, who just lets their
subordinates do all the fighting,
possibly know...!
And yet, I can't bring myself to\nbelieve that you are weak...\nHow is that possible...?
Huh? A banana? Do you want\nto be cut to pieces!?
Mr. Albel is a swordsman, but\nhis build is way too slender. He\nneeds to build some muscle!

And what's with the exposed
midriff? His hairstyle is a bit
too eccentric, too. It's a shame
because he actually has a
pretty handsome face...

Appearance doesn't matter,
you pests. I don't take fashion
advice from someone who's
showing off her own navel and
chest.
H-hey, I'm a girl! This is called\nfashion!
Gideon: Lord Albel, are you\nsafe!
Gideon: What?! Did you people\ndo this to Lord Albel?! Curse\nyou, prepare yourselves!
...They have nothing to do with\nthis. Get back to the castle\nimmediately.
I'll be right behind you. Aquaria\nwill be making their move\nsoon...
Gideon: Yes, sir! Understood!

Hmph. That was a somewhat
interesting conversation. I'll
make a point to remember your
faces.
...Mr. Albel. He seems like a bit\nof a handful, but he's serious\nabout seeking strength.
He'd certainly be a reassuring\nally if he ever joined us.
Hm?
Albel's memories are fading.\n...The spell is reaching its limit.\nLet's head back.
This concludes Albel's story for\nnow.

Stories for various other
Characters are planned for
future release. Please look
forward to them.
